name: 402-lab
description: Delegate a USDC budget in plain words; the agent finds x402 tools (Bazaar + seller catalogs), pays per call inside the cap, returns only the result.
long_description: 402-LAB turns "do this within $1" into a hard spending limit. The human states a budget, the agent calls `mandate_create`, then `discover` (x402 Bazaar with ~15k listed resources, plus any seller `product.json`) and `buy`. Every payment is an x402 exact EIP-3009 USDC authorization signed by the wallet key that stays on this machine. The server, not the model, enforces the total cap, the per-call cap, the network, the USDC asset and the optional seller allow-list; reservations are written before signing and a `request_id` is never paid twice. Testnet (Base Sepolia) by default; set `network` to `eip155:8453` for Base mainnet with real USDC.

tools.name: mandate_status
tools.description: Current delegated budget: total, per-call cap, spent, remaining, expiry.

tools.name: mandate_create
tools.description: Record the budget the human just delegated (total USDC, per-call cap, minutes, allowed sellers). Rejected above the configured maximum.

tools.name: mandate_revoke
tools.description: Stop all further spending under the current mandate immediately.

tools.name: discover
tools.description: Search x402 Bazaar and seller catalogs for payable tools on the configured network.

tools.name: buy
tools.description: Verify one x402 quote against the mandate, reserve, sign, pay and return the tool result.

tools.name: receipts
tools.description: All purchases under this wallet with settlement transaction links.

buyer_private_key.title: Buyer wallet private key
buyer_private_key.description: 0x-prefixed private key of the wallet that pays. Keep only small amounts in it (at most the mandate cap). Never leaves this machine.

network.title: Network
network.description: eip155:84532 = Base Sepolia (test USDC, default). eip155:8453 = Base mainnet (real USDC).

max_usdc.title: Absolute spending cap (USDC)
max_usdc.description: No mandate may exceed this total, whatever the model asks for.

max_minutes.title: Maximum mandate lifetime (minutes)
max_minutes.description: A mandate expires after this many minutes; the model cannot ask for more.

catalog_urls.title: Seller catalog URLs
catalog_urls.description: Comma-separated product.json URLs searched in addition to the x402 Bazaar.
